start_record.expected_result: Use the already authorized real ChatGPT account in App Server and codex-web private homes so fresh Tailnet pages show the account and open the composer without login.

observations.scope_boundary: This task persists one already user-authorized real account in private server files. It does not add or switch accounts, test model execution, claim cross-account continuity, or expose credentials in evidence.

residual_risks: Every Tailnet device allowed to reach port 8214 will receive the same high-privilege real account and workspace access.
The real account login can expire or be revoked and must then be authorized again.
Account switching and cross-account continuity remain outside M6.7.
